title: Disruptive raises $10B fund to make big bets on at least 10 companies
text: Disruptive has made headlines in recent years for pouring money into companies like chip startup Groq and the AI voice-generation startup ElevenLabs.

title: Frontier AI labs say their models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. What does that mean?
text: TechCrunch spoke to the MIT computer scientist charged with explaining OpenAI's latest mind-bending discovery.

title: Google’s Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering
text: Genie 4 can maintain a consistent scene for up to two minutes, double Genie 3's limit, and offers better physics and more humanlike characters.

title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
text: Genie 4: our new world model unlocking unprecedented realism in real-time simulation.

title: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
text: Rohit Patel is departing Meta after eight years working on AI evaluations and reinforcement learning, TechCrunch has exclusively learned. His startup, Ndoc, aims to take on Microsoft Office Suite.

title: Japan internet giant GMO says hackers posted stolen customer data
text: Japan's GMO Internet is verifying alleged customer data posted by suspected hackers following a cloud service breach.

title: Opera introduces a new web standard to let users deploy AI locally in their browser
text: The new standard, WebAI, is designed to work with a variety of AI models.

title: General Compute raises $100 million Series A, countering the neocloud disaster narrative
text: General Compute is betting on inference chips from outside the Nvidia ecosystem.

title: Nvidia backs Indian startup helping companies run AI models with fewer GPUs
text: Simplismart says its annualized revenue run rate has grown 14-fold in six months, with the U.S. accounting for more than half its revenue.

title: OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
text: OpenAI and Oracle are expanding their partnership to bring business applications and AI agents into ChatGPT and power new Oracle offerings.

title: How OpenAI turned its coding tools into dots, an always-on personal assistant
text: Alexander Embiricos, the OpenAI executive responsible for dots, never wants to have a meeting with someone else's AI agent.

title: Cohere says Alibaba’s Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing
text: An AI model said it wouldn’t use any tools, then tried to send something to a server in Beijing anyway, and while researchers say it’s probably a training quirk and not espionage, the whole thing has people asking how much to trust free Chinese AI.

title: How Check Point accelerates vulnerability research with Daybreak
text: With OpenAI Daybreak, Check Point speeds up the research behind new security protections, enabling its analysts to turn vulnerability intelligence into customer defenses faster.

title: Greptile takes bug detection beyond code review with GPT-6 Astra
text: How Greptile uses GPT-6 Astra to test user workflows, Daybreak to strengthen security, and Codex to reduce rework.

title: Anthropic’s IPO filing reveals its strategy for keeping enterprise customers hooked
text: Anthropic’s S-1 shows more than half of its $100,000-plus customers now use both the Claude Platform and a first-party app, a cross-selling playbook reminiscent of Amazon that’s making enterprise customers stickier.

title: SpaceX locks in $40B GPU financing deal with Apollo
text: The financing gives SpaceX another way to fund its rapidly expanding AI ambitions without relying solely on traditional debt markets.

title: Our newest AI Quest: Mapping the human brain
text: Learn AI literacy via Google’s latest AI Quests lesson on neuroscience, “Polar Peaks.”

title: Anthropic officially files for its public debut
text: Anthropic has officially filed for an IPO, revealing soaring revenue, mounting losses, major enterprise adoption, and an unusual governance structure designed to preserve founder control and its AI safety mission.
